data_fields.name: species_redraws
data_fields.donor_constant: up to 51 draws against the spot

data_fields.name: align_shift_max
data_fields.donor_constant: 0 to 5 per species from dungeon alignment (ALIGNWEIGHT 4)

data_fields.name: temperature_match_bonus
data_fields.donor_constant: +3 weight when the zone temperature suits the species

data_fields.name: group_damp_below_level
data_fields.donor_constant: player level below 3: divide by 4; below 5: divide by 2

data_fields.name: max_group
data_fields.donor_constant: no donor cap; Frankendom adds MAX_ATTACKERS = 3

best_idea: A per-tick roll decides whether a monster spawns; the species is drawn by weighted sampling inside a difficulty window set by zone depth and the player's level, placed out of the player's view, with group size damped at low player level.
decision_why: Frankendom needs out-of-view placement, a level-scaled difficulty window and damped groups, and this donor has all three; but its roll is one global number and its groups have no cap, so the roll and the weight table become zone data and a maxGroup cap of MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 is added.
acceptance: Server test: with a fixed seed and a zone roll of 1 in 70, 70,000 ticks give 1,000 spawns within 10%; no spawn lands in the player's view while a free out-of-view tile exists; no group is larger than 3 at any player level.
